build_activation_count_analysis: build a Python module that uses ActivationCountAnalysis to count activations for a PyTorch model with given inputs
run_activation_count_function: run the activation_count function to compute total activations in mega units for a PyTorch model
test_ActivationCountAnalysis_total: test the ActivationCountAnalysis class by calling total to get the total activation count for a model
review_ActivationCountAnalysis_by_operat: review the ActivationCountAnalysis class and use by_operator to get activation counts grouped by operator type
summarize_ActivationCountAnalysis_by_mod: summarize the ActivationCountAnalysis class and use by_module to get activation counts for all submodules
